final_text:
Done in one execution.

- `out/T2/solution.py` — loads the checkpoint, builds keep-indices from 768-row per-head QKV blocks (rows 0..3839 + 4608..6143) and 256-wide dense column blocks (cols 0..1279 + 1536..2047), applies them to all 16 layers, verifies shapes/dtypes/count, then writes.
- `out/T2/model.safetensors` — 244 tensors, float16 preserved.
- `out/T2/REPORT.md` — self-report.

The script fails loudly on missing keys, unexpected input shapes, any of the three required output shapes, and a tensor count other than 244.
